s.note: Teriyaki beef burger with grilled pineapple and Swiss cheese.
s.how: Shape the beef into 8 thin patties and season. Grill the pineapple rings until charred and cut each in half. Cook the patties in a hot pan, brushing with teriyaki, and melt a slice of cheese on each. Build in the toasted buns with mayo, lettuce and pineapple.

s.note: Beef and bean burritos, crisped in the oven. Earl says microwave food will kill you.
s.how: Brown the beef with the onion, cumin and chipotle until dark and dry. Spread each tortilla with beans, add the beef and cheese, and roll up tight. Brush with oil and bake seam down at 200C until crisp. Halve and serve with sour cream and salsa.

m.note: Crisp slow pork with onion and lime.
m.how: Put the pork in a heavy pot with the orange juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, bay leaves, salt and water to just cover. Simmer uncovered until the water is gone and the pork is tender and frying in its own fat. Shred and fry in batches until crisp at the edges. Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, onion, coriander, salsa verde and lime.

m.note: Chicken in a dark chilli and chocolate mole over rice.
m.how: Toast the chillies in a dry pan, then soak them in hot water for 15 minutes. Fry the onion, garlic, almonds and half the sesame, then blend with the drained chillies, tomatoes, cinnamon and stock until smooth. Simmer the sauce until thick and dark, then melt in the chocolate. Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through, while the rice cooks. Serve over the rice with the rest of the sesame on top.

w.n: Wooden stake churros with dark chocolate
w.note: Cinnamon sugar churros and hot chocolate dip.
w.how: Boil the water, butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt, tip in the flour and beat until it leaves the pan. Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs until smooth and glossy. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry until golden. Roll in the cinnamon sugar while hot. Melt the chocolate into the hot cream and serve as a dip.
shop: 1 tbsp caster sugar, plus 100g for rolling@Pantry

d.note: Mexican lager, lime, hot sauce and a salt rim. The Titty Twister pours Chango.
d.how: Rim 4 glasses with lime and dip them in chilli salt. Add ice, the juice of half a lime, hot sauce and soy to each and top with the lager.

shopping: 1 tbsp caster sugar, plus 100g for rolling@Pantry
